picks.title: We must try to be self attentive as much as possible in all circumstances
picks.summary:
In an online meeting with the San Diego Ramana Satsang (ramana-satsang-sd@googlegroups.com) on 13 September 2026, Michael answers various questions about Bhagavan’s teachings.
This episode is available as a video on YouTube, and a more compressed audio copy in Opus format can be downloaded from MediaFire. Advertisement-free videos on the original writings of Bhagavan Ramana with explanations by Michael James can be accessed on our Vimeo video channel.
Books by Sri Sadhu Om and Michael James that are currently available on Amazon:
By Sri Sadhu Om:
► The Path of Sri Ramana (English) 
► El camino
picks.reason: Detailed discussion on Ramana Maharshi's teachings about self-attention and realization.

picks.showTitle: Chinmaya Mission - Gita, Upanishads and Ancient Knowledge
picks.title: The Monkey Mind: How to Master It | Essence of the Geeta | Episode 88
picks.summary: Swami Swaroopananda, Global Head of Chinmaya Mission, is a revered spiritual leader known for his clear, profound Vedanta teachings. His wisdom guides many towards self-discovery and inner peace, making complex concepts accessible and inspiring globally. In this series, Swamiji distills the learnings from the Bhagavad Geeta and explains it in a way that allows everyone to enjoy the essence of the Geeta.
picks.reason: Swami Swaroopananda explains mastering the restless mind using Bhagavad Gita teachings.

picks.title: Chapter 16, verses 1,2 and 3
picks.summary:
Bhagavad Gita Ch. 16 “Yoga of Divine and Devilish Estates” Verses 1, 2, & 3
The lecture discusses twenty-six qualities described as a person's divine estate, acquired through interaction with Prakriti and necessary for liberation from the limitations imposed by the ignorance of the Self.

picks.title: 1821: Krishna Doesn't Need Your Zucchini Bread | But He Wants Your Love
picks.summary: The Bhagavad-gītā sings of Krishna as the Absolute Truth — complete in himself, independent and lacking nothing. He doesn't need anything we can offer him. And yet — he wants our love. Raghunath and Kaustubha explore that paradox through the narration of Krishna's entrance into Mathurā — and what two very different encounters reveal about the one thing that actually matters in our relationship with God. picks.reason: Explores Krishna's nature and the essence of loving God in Bhagavad Gita and Srimad Bhagavatam.
